summary: Nine local passes plus five story-level passes. Real defects found and fixed: three accessibility regressions in the view switcher (a roving tabIndex with no arrow handler stranded keyboard users; the poll-driven rebuild detached both focus and the drawer's focus-return opener; rebinding by story key alone jumped focus between sections, since a frontier story renders twice); empty-frontier copy that asserted dependency-blocking for fresh, finished and in-progress repos in turn; a lossy API change that stripped frontmatter from spec.body for every consumer to fix one renderer; and a P1 where project identity read only lifecycle state, so the data-only bundled example reported its directory name instead of 'Workshop Dispatch'. Derivation discipline holds throughout: every added field is computed per request from committed artifacts, and the Overview consumes them rather than re-deriving the dependency graph in the page (asserted by test).
non_blocking_findings: forge next still embeds runnable commands for agent consumption; the board's own copy now names intents instead. The two audiences are served differently on purpose.
Task progress renders only in the story drawer; cards and Overview stay story-level. Recorded as a remaining gap, deferred to the board-truth story.
residual_risks: The task-row layout finding was raised in five consecutive rounds and rejected each time on unchanged evidence: .tasks li (index.html:406) and .tasks li summary (417) are display:flex; the grid is the one-column list container, not the row. If a future change makes a task row a grid, that rejection stops being valid.
Width proof is structural, not rendered (decision 0027): visual quality at each breakpoint is the functional check's responsibility, not CI's.
